Major AI Developments.title: India will become global AI Platform: CM
Major AI Developments.summary: India is expected to become a global platform for Artificial Intelligence (AI) according to the Chief Minister. The country aims to leverage its technological capabilities to achieve this goal. This development is anticipated to establish India as a major player in the global AI landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: DI Talk Show on India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India Initiatives in Tripura
Major AI Developments.summary: A DI Talk Show discussed the India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India initiatives in Tripura. The event highlighted the potential impact of AI on India's growth and development. Digital India initiatives in Tripura were also explored, focusing on the state's digital transformation.
